content.short: Hexagate secures on-chain activity and digital assets for Web3 providers and end users.
content.description: Hexagate helps make Web3 safe by securing on-chain activity and digital assets. It protects service providers such as wallets, Web3 apps, exchanges, and marketplaces, as well as Web3 companies and end users, from cybersecurity and financial threats before they can affect assets. Hexagate detects and mitigates fraud and scams and maintains ongoing vigilance against cybersecurity and financial exploits to prevent losses and safeguard digital holdings.
